summary: Add st slo chart: draw what is left of one objective or budget over up to seven days, from a local history the daemon appends once a minute

replay.detail: No claim, projection or replay change; the history is a local file log under the state directory and never enters the graph or replicates.

schema.detail: No table, index or migration change.

compatibility.detail: Adds GET /v1/slo/history and st slo chart. Existing routes and commands are unchanged.

manual.detail: Nothing to configure; slo-history under the state directory is created by the daemon and deleted after seven days.

recovery.detail: Swapping back to an older build stops the log; the files can be left or deleted.
